description: Request Runtime-owned completed-phase compaction. Submit concise semantic content only; Runtime preserves user requests, constraints, tasks, errors and evidence. In an isolated correction, supply only changed top-level sections; omitted sections are preserved. No workspace or history is changed by the tool itself.

propertyDescriptions.currentWork: Current investigation or implementation work; no extended reasoning.
propertyDescriptions.decisions: Key decisions and their rationale, without chain-of-thought.
propertyDescriptions.conclusions: Model interpretations of evidence, not self-certified facts.
propertyDescriptions.conclusions[].text: A concise interpretation; Runtime does not treat citation existence as proof.
propertyDescriptions.conclusions[].evidenceIds: Select exact ev_ IDs from the Runtime catalogue. Do not invent IDs. Without supporting evidence retain the claim as a hypothesis.
propertyDescriptions.hypotheses: Unverified explanations, assumptions and candidate requirements.
propertyDescriptions.failedApproaches: Failed approaches and the changed conditions required before retrying.
propertyDescriptions.nextStep: One concrete next action or falsifiable experiment.

guidance: Only currentWork and nextStep are required in the first candidate; empty optional lists are supplied mechanically. On correction replace only the named top-level sections. Never provide coverage flags, user quotes, message indices or an invented evidence registry. Runtime owns all fixed facts and commits only at a safe completed-phase boundary. Model interpretations remain unverified; only recorded observation fields are Runtime facts. Keep completed phases concise and the active thinking/tool chain unchanged.
